mentions.name: Carnyx
mentions.description: Multitrack field recorder app for iPhone (also runs on Mac) with automatic cloud sync, hi-fi audio capture, a built-in mixer, and a social graph so users can share sessions with collaborators by handle and grant them access.
mentions.source_excerpt: Multitrack field recorder with automatic cloud sync for iPhone. I use it for hi-fi recording of band practice and sharing demos with bandmates/collaborators. Great way to send stems too as it runs on the Mac as well and has a built in mixer. There's a social graph so you can send someone a session by typing in their handle and granting access.
